test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only 7 persons sit between F and U. F is at one of the extreme ends of the row. Only 9 persons sit between H and U. Only 12 persons sit between E and H. E is at the extreme right end. H is at the 19th position from the extreme left end. H is 14th from the extreme right end. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given:

 
• A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing the north.
 
• Only 7 persons sit between F and U. F is at one of the extreme ends of the row.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2801f649e3dd6268372cd109191057c65699444342caf28b0159a8ff5b0eb8c2.png] 

 
• Only 9 persons sit between H and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63311310b8ca8554fc69dfe44a790f1adb01cae8bcfdc16f0a33dc12dac85476.png] 

 
• Only 12 persons sit between E and H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e17264aa0bb3107ea82a2b28bbe21750f0a9ec781ce3552f43a47b3422792324.png] 

 
• E is at the extreme right end. H is at the 19th position from the extreme left end. H is 14th from the extreme right end. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c73b7653c19efed589bc8226ee2797ef651f9aaf418d7726accceefb3ac50f9d.png] 

Hence, there are "32" persons that are sitting in a row.
